title: Reply to client interest
subject: Thanks for your interest in {{service_name}}
content:
Hi {{name}},

thanks for reaching out and for your interest in {{service_name}}.
I would be happy to help.

Could you please share:
- what exactly you need,
- your ideal timeline,
- and your budget (if available)?

Then I can suggest the next best step.

Thanks,
{{sender_name}}
ai_prompt: Write a professional and friendly reply to a client who expressed interest in {{service_name}}. Address them as {{name}}. Ask for their requirements, timeline, and budget. Keep it warm, concise, and under 100 words.
